purpose: Compare and adopt HTML-safe application/json bootstrap for the answer map after popup-only SQL projection optimization, preserving complete snapshot data and legacy global consumers.

baseline.description: Baseline after popup projection optimization, before JSON bootstrap. Native binary remains the same for prototype format comparison.

diagnosticEvolution: Every stage records the same product bootstrap/template/module hashes.
Prototype stages preceded optional Windows checkpoints, fresh-browser mode and independently selectable bootstrap-loader. Those diagnostic additions are gated and disabled in speed stages.
Legacy loader override uses the frozen original module at its original import location; its separate hash is recorded.
Current diagnostic/helper hashes are recorded separately; historical script hashes are not inferred. Each sanitized source report has a whole-file hash.
columnAndMedianConventions: A numeric array uses the named columns in this artifact; null means unavailable/not applicable, not zero.
timingMs/proxyMs values are milliseconds. CDP duration deltas are seconds, heap deltas bytes, LayoutCount/RecalcStyleCount counts.
heapDom uses bytes/counts. bootstrapDom/boundary textCodeUnits are logical UTF-16 code units, not allocated bytes.
Boundary iframePerformanceNowMs is local navigation-relative performance.now, not elapsed time from parent open.
Each stage/mode median uses its own3trials, or1functional trial. Independent medians and overlapping/nested timings must not be summed.
Private-commit delta from before-open is computed per trial before taking its median; DifferenceOfMedians fields explicitly subtract independent medians.
Functional operation times have no legacy full-workflow baseline and are not comparative performance claims.

conditions.backendScope: All real-data native/live measurements use the SQLite read-only immutable copy; these are not real PostgreSQL database measurements. Applying the common frontend to PostgreSQL relies on source correspondence and PostgreSQL6/SQLite8 serialization regressions.
conditions.frozenComparison: One acquired HTML snapshot is structurally rewrapped without eval or full-bootstrap JSON.parse in Node. Original value text is retained; fixed wrapper syntax and per-navigation parentOrigin/requestId strings change. Backend map SQL/HTML generation is excluded; automatic initial options still use the real endpoint.
conditions.liveComparison: Retained legacy profiler and rebuilt JSON-template profiler use the same immutable backup and baseline manifest. Actual handler, HTML transfer, initial options and browser work are included through the diagnostic proxy.
conditions.speed: Continuous memory sampling, Windows process probes and per-trial Chrome restart are disabled. Each trial gets a fresh context/page; Chrome is reused within a stage. No unrecorded browser warmup is discarded.
conditions.sampledMemory: Separate prototype-memory stages reuse Chrome with fresh contexts/pages. Precise-memory-info,100ms CDP probes and fixed performance.memory boundaries add work; their timing is not the speed comparison.
conditions.processMemory: Separate Windows stages start fresh Chrome for each trial. Sampling remains enabled; hidden PowerShell runs only at four checkpoints, outside the periodic sampler and after the initial-ready timing. Measurements are sequential rather than atomic.
conditions.caches: Backend and OS caches are not reset. Fresh Chrome does not mean cold DB/OS. Browser contexts isolate HTTP caches and proxy responses are no-store.
conditions.externalResources: External tiles/icons/images are local placeholders. Real authentication and external-resource/network latency are excluded.

metricDefinitions.loadingCleared: Vue loading ref changes after answer-map-ready; does not wait for renderer idle or prove GPU paint.
metricDefinitions.loadingPaintOpportunity: Double requestAnimationFrame after loading clears; scheduling opportunity rather than proof every pixel is painted.
metricDefinitions.combinedReady: Parent scope/options/color-fieldset readiness, shape-renderer idle and frame settling, including automation coordination.
metricDefinitions.serverHandler: Server-Timing handler duration, excluding transfer/proxy work; null for frozen HTML.
metricDefinitions.bootstrapSeparateScripts: Separate scripts surround the legacy literal or inert JSON block. Includes HTML parser/transfer waiting and legacy compilation/evaluation, but excludes later JSON.parse for JSON. Not exclusive JavaScript CPU time.
metricDefinitions.bootstrapJsonParse: Synchronous JSON.parse call only. Loader additionally covers validation/cache/removal; these spans overlap.
metricDefinitions.proxy: Live HTML is buffered/decoded/rewritten/encoded. bootstrapTransformMs is within htmlRewriteMs; socket-send callback is not browser responseEnd.
metricDefinitions.jsHeap: Target/renderer JavaScript heap at the stated GC checkpoint; excludes important DOM/native allocations and is not total application memory. Natural GC may occur.
metricDefinitions.observedMaximum: CDP sampling and fixed performance.memory boundary maxima may miss internal transient peaks and include automation/natural GC; not true instantaneous or full native peaks.
metricDefinitions.privateCommitBytes: Sum of Windows PrivateMemorySize64 for this Chrome instance's validated CDP-listed PIDs: private committed allocation, resident or paged, rather than current physical RAM.
metricDefinitions.sumWorkingSetBytes: Sum of WorkingSet64 resident pages, including shared pages counted in multiple processes; not unique Chrome RSS or unique physical memory.
metricDefinitions.processScope: Only this browser instance's SystemInfo.getProcessInfo PIDs are queried. Node proxy, Rust server, other apps/Chrome instances and absent parent editing map/Pinia are outside the sum. No individual PID/CommandLine is retained.
metricDefinitions.domTextRelease: Attached script CharacterData.length is read without copying the text. Zero means source DOM is detached, not that all related allocations immediately returned to the OS.

interpretation: Frozen mode isolates browser representation while retaining a real options request. The roughly1.5second PC result is not application-wide opening time.
Live SQLite-readonly-copy loading-cleared medians are PC3155.8to2953.1ms and mobile emulation5907.6to4901.9ms. Combined-ready is separately recorded.
Retained JS heap increases by about9.2MiB; this tradeoff is explicit and its V8 internal cause is not inferred.
Fresh-Chrome after-GC private commit falls by about89.2MiB PC and85.8MiB mobile emulation; attached bootstrap text falls from48269105UTF-16code units to0.
Adoption combines observed speed, private-commit allocation and compatibility; it is not a physical-device or every-workload guarantee.
Full geometry/popup data and roughly72.6MB HTML remain. This does not reduce SQL work, API data scope, polling, target limits or cache lifetime.

scope: All11 fixed sections are decoded without eval; object keys are sorted recursively while array order/full strings/numeric precision remain significant.
Only query.as_of is excluded, with its presence and actual equality reported separately.
Individual section hashes are omitted, including the single-account field; only the whole section-digest mapping hash is retained.
Canonical byte counts use ASCII escaping and do not represent HTTP bytes or allocated memory.

contracts: Only the answer-map page emits application/json; other maps keep their legacy global representation.
Parse once, validate before caching, reuse the same reference for later readers/print, and remove source DOM only after success.
Malformed JSON, invalid type/page and invalid pre-existing global data are rejected; fallback does not hide invalid values.
Unicode, HTML-safe script-breakout prevention and own __proto__ property round trips are tested.
PC/mobile real Leaflet initialization, three popup body modes, geometry/current names and full answer history remain compatible.
Search/latest/as_of/scope, inherited view, authenticated native navigation/retry and stale-response discard remain unchanged.
No new API, per-object fetch, Worker, cache policy, DB schema or migration.

functional.resourceNote: One placeholder resource layer remains loading/failed; the existing30second current-display print fallback is used. All1000shapes render, but this is not normal external-background resource completion timing.
functional.popupDetailExpansion: Popup opening is exercised; the selected rendered popup has no details element. This run does not claim a details-expansion interaction.

limitations: Real-data performance is SQLite-readonly-copy only. PostgreSQL correctness/serialization is regression tested, without real PostgreSQL performance or full-application speed claims.
Only3trials per mode/stage are available; results are diagnostic, not statistical guarantees or strict CI wall-time thresholds.
The real fixture has shapes and no markers. Large-marker performance and physical-device GPU/memory are outside this measurement.
Main editing map/Pinia, real authentication, network tiles and backend/Node process memory are outside the Chrome totals.
Full workflow is checked only after adoption, once per mode; operation times are not before/after improvement evidence.
Only completed host-environment runs are included. Raw traces, screenshots, DOM content and private query/data values are not published.

reproduction.input: Create a consistent private read-only immutable SQLite backup and diagnostic output under ignored target; retain the after-popup-projection legacy binary and bootstrap module before changing representation.
reproduction.comparison: Use scripts/performance/compare-answer-map-bootstrap.py on private HTML variants. Retain only the aggregate result and remove private HTML/manifest/backup files.
reproduction.timing: Use separate outputs, run sequentially with builds/tests stopped, and keep speed and memory runs separate.
